نضطغن (form VIII)
# نَضْطَغِنُ (naḍṭaḡinu) /nadˤ.tˤa.ɣi.nu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# نُضْطَغَنُ (nuḍṭaḡanu) /nudˤ.tˤa.ɣa.nu/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# نَضْطَغِنَ (naḍṭaḡina) /nadˤ.tˤa.ɣi.na/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِضْطَغَنَ (iḍṭaḡana)
# نُضْطَغَنَ (nuḍṭaḡana) /nudˤ.tˤa.
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
